name: doors-inward-coverage
description: Door leaves fully cover their opening when closed, and bath/WC + sliding doors open INWARD (into the room they serve, not out over the corridor). Curated flat: the corridor-S bath1/bath2 bifolds, closed then open. Plan doors: a template bath door forced to `sliding`, closed then parked.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const st = window.__store.getState(); st.endTour?.(); st.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); st.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); st.setManualHour?.(13); st.setLightsMode?.('on'); st.hideLoading?.(); st.dismissCallout?.('walk-mode') })()

steps.name: no-wall-fade
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setWallRevealStrength?.(0); window.__look = (px, pz, tx, tz) => { const c = window.__three.camera; c.position.set(px, 1.5, pz); const k = window.__three.controls; k.target.set(tx, 1.1, tz); k.update(); }; 'ok'

steps.name: open-bath-doors
steps.eval: (() => { const st = window.__store.getState(); st.setDoorOpen('door-bath1', true); st.setDoorOpen('door-bath2', true) })()

steps.name: force-sliding
steps.eval: (() => { const st = window.__store.getState(); const plan = st.floorPlan; const area = r => (r.polygon ? 99 : r.width * r.depth); const inRect = (r, x, z) => x >= r.origin[0] - 0.05 && x <= r.origin[0] + r.width + 0.05 && z >= r.origin[1] - 0.05 && z <= r.origin[1] + r.depth + 0.05; const byId = new Map(plan.walls.map(w => [w.id, w])); const cands = []; for (const o of plan.openings) { if (o.kind !== 'door') continue; const w = byId.get(o.wallId); if (!w) continue; const len = Math.hypot(w.end[0] - w.start[0], w.end[1] - w.start[1]); if (!len) continue; const ux = (w.end[0] - w.start[0]) / len, uz = (w.end[1] - w.start[1]) / len; const cx = w.start[0] + ux * (o.offset + o.width / 2), cz = w.start[1] + uz * (o.offset + o.width / 2); const nx = -uz, nz = ux; const rA = plan.rooms.find(r => inRect(r, cx + nx * 0.5, cz + nz * 0.5)); const rB = plan.rooms.find(r => inRect(r, cx - nx * 0.5, cz - nz * 0.5)); if (!rA || !rB) continue; const small = area(rA) < area(rB) ? rA : rB; cands.push({ id: o.id, cx, cz, nx, nz, small: small.name, smallArea: area(small), inA: small === rA }); } cands.sort((a, b) => a.smallArea - b.smallArea); const pick = cands[0]; if (!pick) throw new Error('no interior door found in template'); st.updateOpening(pick.id, { style: 'sliding' }); window.__slide = pick; return JSON.stringify(pick) })()

steps.name: view-slide-outside
steps.eval: (() => { const d = window.__slide; const s = d.inA ? -1 : 1; window.__look(d.cx + d.nx * s * 1.5, d.cz + d.nz * s * 1.5, d.cx, d.cz) })()

steps.name: view-slide-inside
steps.eval: (() => { const d = window.__slide; const s = d.inA ? 1 : -1; window.__look(d.cx + d.nx * s * 1.5, d.cz + d.nz * s * 1.5, d.cx, d.cz) })()
